category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: Free accounts download 10 GB/day at slow speed with ads; the site sells three paid tiers by daily traffic: Premium 20 GB, Premium Pro 50 GB and Premium Max 100 GB per day.

per_object_cap.stated: Premium: 'Uploading files up to 5Gb' (vendor terms); a reseller table lists 10 GB on Premium Pro.

retention.stated: Premium account: 'Storing files for 90 days' (vendor terms); free-account retention is not published.

egress.terms: Traffic is the product: 20, 50 or 100 GB per day depending on tier, with 'no speed limits' claimed for all three.
egress.price_per_tb: no overage price; the tier is the lever

interface_detail: Part of the K2S family, which publishes an API at keep2share.cc/api/v2; FileBoom's own site did not confirm a separate endpoint.
tooling: browser and download managers; JDownloader 2 support is reported for the family
chaining: Only useful when the file is FileBoom-hosted; it is the most expensive per TiB of the K2S family for the same 100 GB/day.

limits.value: 10 GB per day on a free account; 20/50/100 GB per day on Premium, Premium Pro and Premium Max
5 GB on Premium, 10 GB on Premium Pro (reported)

limits_note: The vendor premium page lists Free at 10 GB/day and Premium Max at 100 GB/day and shows 'From $1.22 /day'; the Premium and Premium Pro figures and every plan price are reseller-reported, and a reseller states that the Premium (20 GB) plan is marked 'New users only' on the vendor site.
binding_note: Only Premium Max clears 1 TiB a month with room; the two cheaper tiers cap at 0.55 and 1.36 TiB.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up with a valid e-mail address, a user name and a password, or with a Google account; card and crypto via resellers or the vendor checkout.

reliability_note: The family applies a hard daily counter; a missed day is not recoverable.
confidence_note: Four resellers agree on the 20/50/100 GB structure and within a few dollars on price, which is why the shape is recorded; the exact 30-day total needs the vendor checkout to become documented.
